difference_from_nearest: ISTAICC lets information acquisition itself move a participation/search equilibrium and adds continuation value; CBSCG uses an endogenous routing equilibrium to create the action surface whose latent state determines whether information is worth buying.
external_prior_art: Value of information in Bayesian routing/congestion games with endogenous route response is established; the R386 composition is an internal product architecture, not a new information-economics theorem.
mechanism_removing_comparator: same Wardrop strategic-response project choice using midpoint demand with the CBIA information-acquisition step removed
new_failure_mode: Midpoint-demand infrastructure choice can be wrong when latent demand changes the strategic routing equilibrium and therefore flips the optimal capacity intervention.
non_additive_interaction: Strategic-response equilibrium creates an action boundary in latent demand; CBIA acquires information only when the calibrated demand shell spans different equilibrium-optimal interventions and prices it by avoided decision regret.
